name: Tyndall Air Force Base
location: About 12 miles east of Panama City, on the peninsula between St. Andrew Bay and the Gulf
mission: Home of the 325th Fighter Wing, which is becoming an operational F-35A Lightning II wing (the first F-35As arrived August 1, 2023). Also home to First Air Force and its 601st Air and Space Operations Center, which run air defense of the continental U.S., the 53rd Weapons Evaluation Group and the Air Force Civil Engineer Center.
storm: Hurricane Michael hit the base on October 10, 2018. In April 2019 the Air Force estimated the damage at $4.7 billion; the base is being rebuilt as an "installation of the future."
tenants: First Air Force (Air Forces Northern); 601st Air and Space Operations Center; 53rd Weapons Evaluation Group; 82nd Aerial Targets Squadron; 337th Air Control Squadron; 372nd Training Squadron Det.; Air Force Civil Engineer Center; Air Force Research Laboratory site; 44th Fighter Group (Reserve); Florida Air National Guard Det. 1

name: Naval Support Activity Panama City
host_unit: Naval Support Activity Panama City (Navy Region Southeast)
location: On St. Andrew Bay at the foot of the Hathaway Bridge, Panama City Beach
mission: Runs the base for its tenant commands. The largest, Naval Surface Warfare Center Panama City Division, is one of the Navy's research and test labs for mine warfare, diving and coastal operations. The Naval Diving and Salvage Training Center trains divers from every service.
tenants: Naval Surface Warfare Center Panama City Division; Center for Explosive Ordnance Disposal and Diving; Naval Diving and Salvage Training Center; Navy Experimental Diving Unit; Coast Guard Station Panama City
